name: GSC Indexing Tracker
body:
> Tracker · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Running log of manual "Request Indexing" runs in Google Search Console for Summit AZ, Alphalete, Pipeliners and Prestige, done by Claude through Kim-Main Chrome. It records what was submitted per run, quota blocks, verified-already-indexed skips, 301s removed from the queue, the next queue and open flags. Last run: 2026-10-13 (Pipeliners only, partial). This file is the queue state for the "continue the GSC indexing task" workflow.

# Method (from the tracker)
- Verify each URL with URL Inspection first; skip if already on Google (the Pages report often lags).
- Skip 301s (they never index at that URL) and archives, feeds, category/tag/author pages.
- Quotas are per property, roughly 5 to 15 per day; stop at the first "Quota Exceeded". New or strict properties (Prestige, Pipeliners) need a 2 to 3 day cooldown; do not retry daily.
- Do not resubmit pages already requested; resubmitting does not change priority.
- UI notes: ref-based clicks worked Sep 14; on Oct 13 the tab froze and a coordinate click worked.

# Run history
| Date | Property | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-04 | All four | 14 then 18 more submitted (32 total plus Prestige sitemap). Alphalete 11 (all 18 commercial city pages and 19 blogs now submitted), Summit 14, Pipeliners 3, Prestige 12 (all 6 city and 7 service pages). Prestige sitemap first submitted, Success, 23 pages discovered. |
| 2026-07-07 | Summit | 11 submitted; entire Summit queue cleared. Prestige and Pipeliners quota-blocked. Two Alphalete 301s removed; Alphalete queue empty. |
| 2026-07-08 | Prestige, Pipeliners | 0 submitted, both still quota-blocked. |
| 2026-09-14 | Summit | 4 submitted, completing a 12-page batch started Sep 12. Alphalete 5 service pages were requested Sep 11 to 12. |
| 2026-10-13 | Pipeliners | Partial: 2 requested (/residential-pipe-restoration-guide/, /whole-house-repipe/); 2 verified indexed; 2 skipped as 301s. Pages report 96 indexed / 168 not indexed. |

# Pages report snapshot 2026-07-04
Alphalete 23 crawled-not-indexed, 7 x 404; Summit 46 discovered-not-indexed, 16 crawled-not-indexed, 11 redirect; Pipeliners 118 crawled-not-indexed (prior validation failed), 60 noindex, 30 robots-blocked, 26 discovered-not-indexed.

# Still to do (as of Oct 13)
- Pipeliners: /common-myths-about-trenchless-sewer-repair-debunked/ (request did not confirm), /pipelining-myths-debunked/ (possible overlap), /leak-detection-services-in-phoenix-arizona/, /pipeline-locating-what-it-is-and-why-its-important/.
- Older queue entries: Prestige hub pages, /about/, /contact/ and three blogs; Pipeliners /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/ and about 16 to 19 blogs.

# Open flags
- Summit /water-heater-services-phoenix/ redirect: intentional?
- Alphalete contact-us, gallery, projects 301 targets unverified.
- Pipeliners crawled-not-indexed validation failed; needs re-validation.
- Alphalete commercial pages showed "No referring sitemaps detected".
- Alphalete's 14 thin /service-areas/{city}-co pages are deliberately not force-indexed (cleanup plan).
